name: GPT-Red
description: An automated AI red-teaming system developed by OpenAI, trained via self-play reinforcement learning to simulate prompt injection attacks and discover vulnerabilities in language models prior to deployment.
keyFeatures: Automated adversarial red-teaming simulation at scale
Tailored to detect and mitigate prompt injection vulnerabilities
Used internally to secure GPT-5.6 and other subsequent OpenAI models
curatorNotes: Registered GPT-Red as an internal-use automated red-teaming system/research preview announced on 2026-07-15. Not a downloadable model or developer API.
